                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/23692312" title="发布于 2026-11-17 12:01">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">17. a=b=5 谁的值变了？赋值运算符实战详解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2>等号</h2>
<p>最基本的赋值就是 <code>=</code>。右边算出一个值，放进左边的变量。</p>
<p>动画视频在《<a class="name ellipsis" href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1mQWR68EbB/" target="_blank" data-v-3995fb7c="" rel="noopener nofollow">a=b=5 谁的值变了？赋值运算符实战详解</a>》。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let name: string = 'Cool'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
let age: number </span>= 18<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
console.log(name, age);</span></pre>
</div>
<p>连续赋值写成 <code>x = y = 5</code>。等号从右边算：先做 <code>y = 5</code>，再把这个 5 交给 <code>x</code>。两个变量都是 5。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">let x: number;
let y: number;
x </span>= y = 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
console.log(</span>'x =', x, 'y =', y);</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="x和y都是5" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202611/1919157-20261117115643468-1849917857.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;这样写能跑。要看清楚，就分开写成两行。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let x: number = 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
let y: number </span>= 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
console.log(</span>'x =', x, 'y =', y);</pre>
</div>
<p>先开启预览器，再打开日志面板，按 Ctrl + S 保存，才能看到输出。后面的 <code>console.log</code> 也一样。</p>
<h2>复合赋值</h2>
<p><code>num = num + 5</code> 写起来长。<code>+=</code>、<code>-=</code>、<code>*=</code>、<code>/=</code>、<code>%=</code>、<code>**=</code> 把运算和赋值合成一步。<code>num += 5</code> 就是 <code>num = num + 5</code>。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let num: number = 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
num </span>+= 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
console.log(</span>'+= 5 后:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, num);
num </span>-= 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
console.log(</span>'-= 3 后:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, num);
num </span>*= 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
console.log(</span>'*= 2 后:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, num);
num </span>/= 4;
console.log('/= 4 后:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, num);
num </span>%= 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
console.log(</span>'%= 5 后:', num);</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="复合赋值" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202611/1919157-20261117115825444-930124189.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;<code>**=</code> 是先做乘方，再赋回去。<code>2 **= 3</code> 就是 2 的 3 次方，得到 8。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let p: number = 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
p </span>**= 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
console.log(</span>'**= 3 后:', p);</pre>
</div>
<p>复合赋值的右边会先算完。<code>v *= 3 + 1</code> 不是先乘 3 再加 1。3 加 1 先得到 4，再用原来的 2 去乘 4，结果是 8。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let v: number = 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
v </span>*= 3 + 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
console.log(</span>'v *= 3 + 1 的结果:', v);</pre>
</div>
<p>拿不准运算顺序，就加上括号。写出来和上面是同一个 8。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let v2: number = 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
v2 </span>*= (3 + 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
console.log(</span>'v2 *= (3 + 1) 的结果:', v2);</pre>
</div>
<p>好了，赋值运算符讲完了，点赞关注不迷路！</p>

</div>
